dsh-tailscale-gateway is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Private Tailscale access for DeepSeek Harness Web that allowlists users from the trusted Tailscale-User-Login header that Serve injects, with a loopback-only gateway and guarded Serve setup.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ac1fe78cdbe700e97045.html
